name: USDJPY Short-Only Donchian Breakout
description: FX trend-following short-only breakout strategy on USDJPY using 55-day Donchian Channels. Short entry on lower band breakdown with ADX(14) > 20 trend filter. Exit via opposing Donchian upper band crossover. Risk-based sizing via risk_unit: 2% equity risk per trade with stop distance = 2× ATR(14).
source:
# USDJPY Short-Only Donchian Breakout Strategy
# =============================================================================
# FX trend-following SHORT-ONLY breakout strategy on USDJPY using 55-day
# Donchian Channels for entry/exit signals with ADX(14) > 20 trend filter.
#
# RULES:
# - Short entry: Close < Prior bar's 55-day Donchian Lower AND ADX(14) > 20
# - Exit short:  Close > Prior bar's 55-day Donchian Upper Band
# - No stop loss — exit solely via opposing Donchian band
# - Sizing:      Fixed 10% of equity per trade
# - Short-only
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# 55-Day Donchian Channel (highest high / lowest low over 55 days)
donchian = donchian_channel(window=55)(high, low)
upper_band = donchian.donchian_upper
lower_band = donchian.donchian_lower

# Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias
# Today's high/low contributes to today's channel — compare against PRIOR bar
upper_band_prior = upper_band >> 1
lower_band_prior = lower_band >> 1

# 14-Day ATR for event marker context
atr14 = atr(period=14)(high, low, close)

# ADX(14) trend strength filter — lag by 1 to match lagged bands
adx_val = adx(period=14)(high, low)
adx_prev = adx_val >> 1
trending = adx_prev > 20

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY / EXIT SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# Short breakout signal
short_breakout = close < lower_band_prior

# Donchian upper band exit for shorts
exit_short_signal = close > upper_band_prior

# Hold short state until opposing band exit fires
short_state = hold_until()(enter=short_breakout, exit=exit_short_signal)

# Apply ADX trend filter — only enter when trending
short_entry = short_state and trending

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Short-only zone — exit_short_signal wired as long_entry to close short positions
# (no actual long trades are held; the "long" signal serves purely as the exit trigger)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=exit_short_signal, short_entry=short_entry)

# Fixed position sizing: 10% of equity per trade
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.pips)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=atr14 * 2)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Mark short breakout entries
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Short Breakout Entry",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(title="Lower Band", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(title="ADX(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, lower_band_prior, adx_prev, atr14, short_entry)
